steps.name: ring-1-pure-core
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; test -z "$(git diff --name-only issue-11 -- main/display/display.c main/display/orb_edge_arc.c main/main.c main/app apps tools/orb-manager)" && gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I main/display -c main/display/orb_ring.c -o /dev/null && grep -q 'ORB_RING_BREATHE' main/display/orb_ring.h && grep -q 'ring_blend565' main/display/orb_ring.c && python3 tools/host_ring_test.py | tail -1 | grep -q 'RESULT: pass' && python3 tools/host_ring_test.py --mutations > /tmp/ring1m.log 2>&1 && grep -q 'mutants caught' /tmp/ring1m.log && ! grep -q MISSED /tmp/ring1m.log

steps.name: ring-2-firmware-sdk
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; python3 apps/sdk/orbsdk.py binds && grep -q '"ring_set"' apps/sdk/binds.json && grep -q '"ring_clear"' apps/sdk/binds.json && grep -q 'imp_ring_set' main/app/orb_app_wasm.c && grep -q 'CAP_RING' main/app/orb_svc.h && grep -q '"ring"' main/app/orb_app_manifest.c && grep -q 'CAP_RING' main/menu/menu_view.c && grep -q 'orb_edge_arc_shown' main/display/orb_edge_arc.h && grep -q '"ring"' main/net/orb_net.c && python3 tools/host_menu_test.py | tail -1 | grep -q 'all host checks pass' && python3 tools/host_svc_test.py && python3 tools/host_orbapp_reader_test.py && python3 tools/host_orbapp_install_test.py && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps && test -z "$(git diff --name-only issue-11 -- tools/orb-manager)"

steps.name: ring-3-color-setting
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH; grep -q 'color' tools/orbapp.py && grep -q '"color"' tools/orb-manager/web/tabs.js && grep -q 'ORB_SETUI_COLOR' main/app/orb_setui.c && python3 tools/host_orbapp_test.py | tail -1 | grep -q '0 failed' && python3 tools/host_setui_test.py --mutations | tail -1 | grep -q 'mutants caught' && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'TestJs|TestUI|TestWebui' -v . 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ring3.log && grep -q -- '--- PASS' /tmp/ring3.log && ! grep -q -- '--- FAIL' /tmp/ring3.log && cd .. && ORB_CLANG=/usr/lib/llvm-21/bin/clang make check-apps
